## Foods & dishes
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 106 recipes tagged `puerto-rican`; [[RecipeDB2]] ≈220 in v1; [[WorldCuisines]] 17 dishes (6 Puerto Rico-only, e.g. arroz con gandules, pasteles, quesito; `Puerto Rican` label 8).
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- US territory: [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the natural FCT, though with few island-specific foods.
- [[NPASS]] 11 specimen pairs; Duke folds Puerto Rico into the United States.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 59 rows (29 concentrations, 30 reproducibility). [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Puerto Rican composition data beyond USDA; Duke records are merged into the US.
